headword: {侵食作用|しんしょくさよう}

definitions.explanation: The geological process by which water, wind, or ice gradually wears away rock and soil and carries the material elsewhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{侵食作用|しんしょくさよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{谷|たに}→谷：02223_tani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{侵食作用|しんしょくさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧。
examples.english: Wind erosion wears away the rock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{侵食作用|しんしょくさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧いく。
examples.english: Erosion over long ages gradually reshapes the landscape.

notes:
USAGE: {侵食作用|しんしょくさよう} is the geological action of erosion, combining ⟦{侵食|しんしょく}→侵食：10927_shinshoku⟧ (erosion) with ⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧ (action, effect). It is common in earth-science contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{侵食作用|しんしょくさよう}: water erosion
- {侵食作用|しんしょくさよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to undergo erosion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風化作用|ふうかさよう}→風化作用：29627_fuukasayou⟧: weathering — the breakdown of rock in place, without transport
- ⟦{堆積|たいせき}→堆積：29631_taiseki⟧: deposition — the opposite process, in which sediment builds up
